record.dic_text:
06578 P@rath {per-awth'}

字根已不使用, 意為向前衝破; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Euphrates 19; 19

幼發拉底河 = "豐收"
1) 西亞最大最長的河流; 發源自亞美尼亞山上二個主要的源頭
   並且流入波斯灣.和合本作"伯拉河"
record.edic_text:
06578 P@rath {per-awth'}

from an unused root meaning to break forth;; n pr m

AV - Euphrates 19; 19

Euphrates = "fruitfulness"
1) the largest and longest river of western Asia; rises from two chief
   sources in the Armenian mountains and flows into the Persian Gulf
